Service

A press release report your CFO will not roll their eyes at.

Impressions are a currency invented by people who did not want to be measured. Here is what we count instead.

Start a campaignRequest a sample report
Quick answer PressCosmos analytics measures press release performance through referral sessions, backlink inventory with authority and follow status, AI citation share across nine answer engines, brand search lift, and where possible pipeline and revenue attribution via UTM and CRM integration.

Metrics

The four numbers that matter

Referral sessions

Real people arriving from a real outlet, segmented by source and session quality.

Link equity earned

Domains linking to you, with authority and follow status — nofollow syndication counted separately.

AI citation share

How often and how accurately answer engines name you for your tracked questions.

Brand demand lift

Change in branded search volume in the four weeks after distribution.

Reporting

Built for three different audiences

For the comms lead

Campaign-level view: what went out, where it landed, what the tone was, what to do differently next time.

For the executive

One page: reach, quality of coverage, citations, and the trend against the previous two campaigns.

For finance

Attribution view: assisted conversions, pipeline influenced, cost per qualified session, with methodology documented.

A note on attribution honesty Most PR-attributed revenue is assisted, not last-click. We show you assisted models with the assumptions written down, and we never claim a direct causal link that the data cannot support.
